name: finterest
author: Finterest
description: Finterest is a local, offline desktop app that helps a single user visualize their monthly budget more clearly than with a simple calculator.

scripts.dev:electron:build: tsup src/electron/main.ts src/electron/preload.ts --format cjs --external electron --out-dir dist/electron --sourcemap --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsup src/electron/main.ts src/electron/preload.ts --format cjs --external electron --out-dir dist/electron --sourcemap
scripts.dist: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --config.directories.output=install/windows
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --config.directories.output=install/mac
scripts.dist:linux: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux AppImage --config.directories.output=install/linux
